_comment: T-3153: per CKAN organization, 10 questions a citizen asks, each in sk and en. expect: every regex must match the answer (case-insensitive); cite: a citation URL must contain it; forbid: no regex may match. Facts read from data.dev CKAN package_show/package_search and the dev NGSI-LD counts (T-4496 expected values) on 2026-10-18.
